item.summary: fix(subagents): bound escaped output for the third child-result call site (#124171) formatChildResultData was the last of three identical Child result/Subagent result wrapPromptDataBlock call sites without maxEscapedChars/truncationMarker. wrapPromptDataBlockWithTag truncates to maxChars before escaping <>, so an angle-bracket-dense child result (code/XML/HTML output) could still expand the escaped block up to ~4x the intended 512-char budget. Bring this site in line with the other two, already fixed by carrier PR #119731 (agent-steering-queue.ts, internal-events.ts). Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
